source: Owner's Sphere Compendium (LocalSources/04_spheres_talents/Tianxia_Sphere_Compendium_Latest_R0I_85Spheres.md: glossary line 377 and 'If an object needs AC, hit points, damage thresholds, or break DCs, use the 2024 object ... guidance') defers to the 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide 'Objects' rules; the numbers below are that table. Spheres 5e and the owner's texts add no default object numbers.
materials_note: D&D 2024 DMG, Object Armor Class table (cloth, paper, rope 11; crystal, glass, ice 13; wood, bone 15; stone 17; iron, steel 19; mithral 21; adamantine 23).
sizes_note: D&D 2024 DMG, Object Hit Points table (average of Tiny 1d4/2d4, Small 1d6/3d6, Medium 1d8/4d8, Large 1d10/5d10). A Huge or Gargantuan object is a collection of Large or smaller sections, each with its own hit points: place one object per section.
immune_note: D&D 2024 DMG: objects are immune to Poison and Psychic damage.
threshold_note: Damage Threshold (2024 glossary, which the owner's compendium adopts): immunity to all damage unless one attack or effect deals at least the threshold; then it takes the damage as normal. The 2024 rules print no default threshold, so an object has one only when its preset (see presets_note; 2026-10-08 catalog) or its placement gives it one; a placement's own number overrides its preset's.
flammable_note: Materials that burn (flavour only: the fight has no burning rule for placed objects).

door.name: Wooden door
door.description: A hinged wooden door set in a frame; swings open and shut.

gate.name: Iron gate
gate.description: A barred iron gate wide enough for a cart to pass through.

barricade.name: Wooden barricade
barricade.description: Sharpened stakes lashed to a crossbeam, driven into the ground to stop a charge.

wall_section.name: Stone wall section
wall_section.description: A course of dressed masonry filling its square.

pillar.name: Stone pillar
pillar.description: A tall fluted stone column holding up a roof or roofline.

statue.name: Stone statue
statue.description: A carved stone figure on a plinth.

ice_block.name: Ice block
ice_block.description: A faceted block of clear ice, melted fast by fire.

barrel.name: Barrel
barrel.description: A bound wooden cask, standing on end.

chest.name: Iron-bound chest
chest.description: A domed wooden chest banded in iron.

banner.name: Banner pole
banner.description: A lacquered banner pole flying a war standard.

rope.name: Rope
rope.description: A coil of rope lying on the ground.

window.name: Glass window
window.description: A glass window in a wall.

bell.name: Bronze bell
bell.description: A temple bell hanging from a wooden beam.

custom.name: Object
custom.description: An unlisted object; a marker post stands in for it.

incense_burner.name: Bronze incense burner
incense_burner.description: A squat bronze censer on three short legs, coiled ash and a burnt stick of incense inside. Standing furniture: it does not fill its square.

prayer_wheel.name: Prayer wheel
prayer_wheel.description: A painted wooden drum spins on an iron spindle atop a waist-high post, engraved mantras running round its side.

bronze_ding.name: Bronze ding cauldron
bronze_ding.description: A three-legged ritual bronze vessel wide enough to fill the square it stands in; its thick cast walls shrug off anything but a solid blow.

stone_guardian_lion.name: Stone guardian lion
stone_guardian_lion.description: A carved stone lion on a low plinth, guarding a threshold; too solid to walk through and tough enough to laugh off a glancing hit.

sutra_shelf.name: Sutra shelf
sutra_shelf.description: An open wooden shelf stacked with bound sutra scrolls and prayer slips.

meditation_cushion.name: Meditation cushion
meditation_cushion.description: A round cloth cushion stuffed with kapok, set on the floor for seated meditation.

temple_gong.name: Temple gong
temple_gong.description: A broad bronze gong hangs from a lacquered wooden frame, struck to mark the hour.

offering_table.name: Offering altar table
offering_table.description: A low altar table bearing fruit, incense and a cup of wine for the ancestors.

stone_lantern.name: Stone lantern
stone_lantern.description: A carved stone lantern on a post, its little window glowing with a candle inside.

market_stall.name: Market stall
market_stall.description: A wooden vendor's stall with a cloth awning, loaded with wares; it fills its square until knocked down.

produce_cart.name: Vendor's cart
produce_cart.description: A two-wheeled hand cart heaped with vegetables and baskets, blocking the square it is left in.

woven_basket.name: Woven basket
woven_basket.description: A tall wicker basket, lid askew, stuffed with cloth bundles.

grain_sack.name: Grain sack
grain_sack.description: A burlap sack slumped against the wall, heavy with grain.

water_barrel.name: Water barrel
water_barrel.description: An open-topped rain barrel, rope-handled, kept full for washing and fires.

village_well.name: Stone well
village_well.description: A round stone well with a peaked roof and a winch; its thick stone fills the square and shrugs off anything but a solid blow.

haystack.name: Haystack
haystack.description: A tall stack of loose hay, high enough to block sight and movement until it is scattered.

fence_section.name: Fence section
fence_section.description: A length of post-and-rail farm fencing, filling its square like a simple barrier.

weapon_rack.name: Weapon rack
weapon_rack.description: A wooden rack holding spears, blades and spare shields for a watch post.

war_brazier.name: Iron brazier
war_brazier.description: A standing iron bowl heaped with glowing coals, its cast walls shrugging off anything but a solid hit.

palisade_section.name: Palisade section
palisade_section.description: A row of sharpened logs driven upright and lashed together, filling its square like a barricade.

sandbag_wall.name: Sandbag wall
sandbag_wall.description: Sacks of earth and rubble stacked into a low rampart; packed fill swallows anything but a solid blow.

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.description: A siege crossbow bolted to its timber frame, filling the square it is wheeled into.

camp_banner.name: Camp banner
camp_banner.description: A plain cloth standard planted on a bare wooden pole to mark a camp or rally point.

army_tent.name: Army tent
army_tent.description: A canvas command tent pegged over its frame, filling its square until torn down.

ammo_crate.name: Ammunition crate
ammo_crate.description: A wooden crate of arrows and crossbow bolts, lid pried half off.

alchemy_furnace.name: Alchemy furnace
alchemy_furnace.description: A clay-lined stone furnace for smelting ore or refining pills, its firebox glowing within; too solid to see or walk through and tough against a glancing blow.

pill_cabinet.name: Pill cabinet
pill_cabinet.description: A wooden apothecary cabinet of tiny labelled drawers, each holding a different pill or herb.

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.description: A sturdy, scarred wooden workbench built for heavy use, fitted with a vice and a row of tools.

blacksmith_anvil.name: Blacksmith's anvil
blacksmith_anvil.description: A solid iron anvil bedded into a thick stump; small, but too heavy and solid to walk through.

herb_drying_rack.name: Herb drying rack
herb_drying_rack.description: A wooden frame hung with bundles of drying roots and herbs.

fallen_log.name: Fallen log
fallen_log.description: A great fallen trunk lying across the ground, solid enough to fill its square until it is chopped through.

tree_stump.name: Tree stump
tree_stump.description: A wide, weathered tree stump, its cut top ringed with growth lines.

boulder_pile.name: Boulder pile
boulder_pile.description: A jumble of broken boulders and scree, filling its square; a glancing hit barely chips it.

rowboat.name: Rowboat
rowboat.description: A wooden rowboat, oars shipped, filling the square it rests in until its hull is staved in.

dock_section.name: Dock section
dock_section.description: A plank section of a wooden pier, walkable but breakable underfoot.

dining_table.name: Dining table
dining_table.description: A long wooden dining table, set for a meal.

wooden_bed.name: Bed
wooden_bed.description: A simple wood-framed bed with a stuffed mattress and folded blanket.

folding_screen.name: Folding screen
folding_screen.description: A tall folding screen of painted panels, standing open enough to block the sight-line across it.

bookcase.name: Bookcase
bookcase.description: A tall wooden bookcase crowded with scrolls and bound volumes, filling its square against the wall.

carved_throne.name: Carved throne
carved_throne.description: An ornate, high-backed wooden throne, carved and gilded for a seated lord.

steamer_trunk.name: Steamer trunk
steamer_trunk.description: A flat-topped travel trunk bound in leather straps and iron corners.

lacquer_chest.name: Lacquer chest
lacquer_chest.description: A red-lacquered treasury chest with brass fittings, bigger and sturdier than a simple chest.
